implementation.targetScope: VentiMath theme and CSS-variable generation, sx and responsive token transforms, styled variants and overrides, Box/Stack/Grid/Container, color helpers, ThemeProvider and media-query lifecycle beneath unchanged Material 9.5.0 and app 7.2.0 on React 19.3.1. Pre-hydration scripts, custom color-scheme persistence, transition suppression and legacy Grid component are outside verified scope.

changes: Uses VPM utility, theming and styling foundations; no Babel, prop-types or MUI type-helper runtime dependencies.
Rejects cyclic sx/theme-variable input and nonfinite breakpoints; own-property token resolution and prototype-safe output construction.
Stable subscriptions survive parent renders; provider changes within a mode preserve focused input DOM and selection.

caller.scope: FuseTheme, component sx/style callbacks, Material forms, menus, tabs, dialogs and layout. VentiMath supplies theme changes itself. Source verification does not establish app adoption.
